variables.name: Device Type
variables.description: Device type (desktop/mobile/tablet) collected automatically by AEP Web SDK. Supports responsive mobile-first delivery tracking (BRD 103).

variables.name: Tracking Code (s.campaign)
variables.description: Native campaign tracking code sourced from URL query parameter. Supports Klook CTA / media promotion attribution (BRD 105, 1401).

variables.name: Campaign Source
variables.description: SAINT classification of s.campaign — traffic source.

variables.name: ECID
variables.description: Experience Cloud ID — primary device/visitor identifier. Mandatory baseline.

variables.name: Page URL
variables.description: Full page URL of the current hit. Mandatory baseline.

variables.name: Business Unit
variables.description: Business unit / site identifier. Mandatory baseline.

variables.name: Environment
variables.description: Environment flag (production/staging) driving the Production Data Only segment. Mandatory baseline.

variables.name: Login Status
variables.description: Visitor login/registration status (registered/unregistered). Registration is optional with full content access regardless (BRD 201, 203).

variables.name: Visitor Profile ID
variables.description: Hashed visitor/profile identifier for email-registered visitors managed via AEP & RT-CDP. [Hashed — PII] SHA-256 hashed in JS before entering the data layer (BRD 204, 1603).

variables.name: Session Cluster Hash
variables.description: Session hash used for circle/loop clustering to power 'Trending with your circle' chip (BRD 703). Derived client-side, non-PII.

variables.name: Student Cohort Flag
variables.description: Derived student cohort flag from geolocation cluster, visit timing and referral source. Not stored as permanent PII; refreshed annually (BRD 1806).

variables.name: Page Name
variables.description: Friendly page name for every tracked page. Mandatory baseline / Adobe Analytics instrumentation (BRD 101).

variables.name: Site Section
variables.description: Top-level site section (programme, installation, trails, map, info). Drives content structure reporting (BRD 104).

variables.name: Page Type
variables.description: Page template type (listing, detail, policy, map). Supports programme/installation listing display tracking (BRD 104).

variables.name: Legal Page Name
variables.description: Identifies Privacy Policy, Terms of Use, Cookie Policy and government disclaimer page views (BRD 106, 107, 108, 1812).

variables.name: Brand Compliance Flag
variables.description: Flags page compliance with Heritage SG brand guidelines / disclaimer presence (BRD 106, 109).

variables.name: Programme ID
variables.description: Unique identifier of the festival programme/installation being viewed (BRD 104).

variables.name: Programme Title
variables.description: Display title of the programme/installation (BRD 104).

variables.name: Venue Name
variables.description: Venue associated with the programme/installation within the Bras Basah–Bugis precinct (BRD 104, 401).

variables.name: Unlocked Content Flag
variables.description: Indicates whether optional unlocked content is present/surfaced for the installation (BRD 602, 605, 1104).

variables.name: First Festival Year
variables.description: firstFestivalYear content attribute from AEMaaCS model (BRD 1104).

variables.name: Trail Name
variables.description: Curated self-guided trail being viewed, saved or followed (BRD 501, 502).

variables.name: Itinerary ID
variables.description: Identifier of a custom itinerary created, shared or adopted by a visitor (BRD 503, 505, 506).

variables.name: Ticketing CTA Destination
variables.description: Captures the off-site Klook ticketing CTA destination when a visitor clicks through (BRD 105).

variables.name: Consent Tier
variables.description: Three-tier consent selection (Tier 0 Functional, Tier 1 Festival Marketing, Tier 2 Year-Round NHB) captured at registration (BRD 301, 302).

variables.name: Consent Action
variables.description: Consent action type (grant/withdraw) via registration or self-service settings (BRD 303, 304).

variables.name: Cookie Consent Category
variables.description: Cookie consent categories accepted (Strictly Necessary, Analytics & Performance, Personalisation & Targeting) (BRD 1808, 1809, 1811).

variables.name: Registration Trigger Moment
variables.description: The moment/context that triggered a registration prompt (first QR scan, itinerary adoption, etc.). Supports funnel reporting by trigger (BRD 603, 1205).

variables.name: Check-in Installation ID
variables.description: Installation ID captured on a confirmed QR check-in against the registered visitor's profile (BRD 601, 604, 1803).

variables.name: Location Permission State
variables.description: Whether location permission was granted or denied, driving proximity sorting vs default listing behaviour (BRD 403, 404).

variables.name: Derived Zone Label
variables.description: Client-side derived geolocation zone label passed to Adobe Target. Raw GPS never stored server-side (BRD 1802).

variables.name: Venue Crowd Density
variables.description: Live per-venue crowd density indicator derived from real-time Adobe Analytics session data (BRD 405, 406).

variables.name: Itinerary Suggestion Type
variables.description: Type of dismissible inline optimisation suggestion surfaced for itinerary conflicts/inefficiencies (BRD 504).

variables.name: Share Method
variables.description: Native device share channel used for itinerary sharing (no social OAuth) (BRD 505, 705).

variables.name: Programme Sort Context
variables.description: Auto-sort / urgency context for programme listing (current-night, urgency label, post-9pm last-chance) (BRD 701).

variables.name: Recommendation Source
variables.description: Source of surfaced recommendation ('Your picks tonight', 'Trending with your circle', Community Picks) (BRD 702, 703, 705).

variables.name: Target Activity Name
variables.description: Adobe Target activity/use-case name for personalisation lift and conversion reporting (BRD 706, 1203).

variables.name: Target Experience Name
variables.description: Adobe Target experience/variant served, mirrored to Analytics via A4T (BRD 706, 1203).

variables.name: Brand Concierge Intent
variables.description: Classified visitor intent for a Brand Concierge query (programme discovery, trail recommendation, venue info, general) (BRD 1405, 1406).

variables.name: Brand Concierge Outcome
variables.description: Outcome of a Brand Concierge interaction (answered, escalated, failed) for engagement/escalation reporting (BRD 1406).

variables.name: Concierge Query Term
variables.description: Search/query term entered into Brand Concierge for query-intent analysis (BRD 1405, 1406). Populated via search dimension.

variables.name: Page Name
variables.description: OOTB page name captured automatically by AEP Web SDK. Mirrors Page Name eVar for pathing/PatternMatch reporting.

variables.name: Custom Page View
variables.description: Custom page view counter fired on every page load across all website pages.

variables.name: Page Load Time (ms)
variables.description: Numeric page load time in milliseconds. Pairs with Page Load Time Instances to build Avg Page Load Time calculated metric.

variables.name: Page Load Time Instances
variables.description: Counter incremented each time a page load time is recorded. Denominator for Avg Page Load Time calculated metric.

variables.name: Registration Start
variables.description: Fires when a visitor begins the email registration flow. Start event of the registration funnel.

variables.name: Registration Complete
variables.description: Fires when email registration is verified via one-time code or link. Complete event of the registration funnel.

variables.name: Registration Fail
variables.description: Fires when a registration attempt fails (invalid code, expired link, error). Fail event of the registration funnel; mobile-optimised flow.

variables.name: Registration Prompt Shown
variables.description: Fires when the dismissible email registration prompt is displayed (e.g. on first QR scan by an unauthenticated visitor). Supports registration-trigger-moment funnel reporting.

variables.name: Registration Prompt Dismissed
variables.description: Fires when the visitor dismisses the registration prompt. Measures opt-out of the registration trigger moment.

variables.name: Consent Granted
variables.description: Fires when a visitor grants a consent tier (Tier 1 Festival Marketing or Tier 2 Year-Round NHB) via positive action at registration.

variables.name: Consent Withdrawn
variables.description: Fires when a visitor withdraws consent via self-service profile settings, effective immediately.

variables.name: Cookie Consent Submitted
variables.description: Fires when a visitor submits cookie consent choices via the PDPA cookie banner or settings control (categories: Strictly Necessary, Analytics & Performance, Personalisation & Targeting).

variables.name: Programme/Installation Listing View
variables.description: Fires on display of a festival programme or installation listing (title, description, venue, dates, times).

variables.name: Klook Ticketing CTA Click
variables.description: Fires when a visitor clicks the Klook ticketing call-to-action directing off-site. No ticketing is built on the SNF website.

variables.name: Unlocked Content View
variables.description: Fires when unlocked content visible only to physically scanned-in visitors is viewed on a programme detail page. No empty state when absent.

variables.name: Map Interaction
variables.description: Fires on interaction with the Bras Basah–Bugis precinct map (pin tap, zoom, listing open). Supports map interaction dashboard.

variables.name: Location Permission Granted
variables.description: Fires when a visitor grants location permission, enabling proximity-based sorting of map and listings by walking distance.

variables.name: Location Permission Denied
variables.description: Fires when a visitor denies location permission; default listing behaviour applies without degradation.

variables.name: Trail Saved
variables.description: Fires when a registered visitor saves/follows a curated self-guided trail.

variables.name: Itinerary Created/Updated
variables.description: Fires when a visitor creates or updates a custom itinerary by adding chosen programmes and installations.

variables.name: Itinerary Optimisation Suggestion Shown
variables.description: Fires when a dismissible, non-blocking inline optimisation suggestion is surfaced for itinerary conflicts or inefficiencies.

variables.name: Itinerary Shared
variables.description: Fires when a visitor shares an itinerary via native device share (no social platform OAuth).

variables.name: Shared Itinerary Viewed
variables.description: Fires when a shared itinerary is viewed without authentication.

variables.name: Itinerary Adopted (One-Tap)
variables.description: Fires on one-tap adoption of a shared itinerary; triggers a light registration prompt. Unique festival-window adoptions feed Community Picks (≥10).

variables.name: QR Check-in
variables.description: Fires when a QR scan is recorded against a registered visitor's profile as a confirmed check-in (installation ID and timestamp). Venue check-in derived exclusively from QR scans, not GPS.

variables.name: Bookmark Added
variables.description: Fires when a visitor bookmarks a programme. Feeds the 'Your picks tonight' bookmark-based feed.

variables.name: Personalised Recommendation Served
variables.description: Fires when an Adobe Target personalised recommendation is served (e.g. affinity-matched 'Your picks tonight', 'Trending with your circle' chip, returning-visitor banner).

variables.name: Personalised Recommendation Click
variables.description: Fires when a visitor clicks a personalised recommendation. Supports Adobe Target lift/conversion reporting per use case.

variables.name: Brand Concierge Interaction
variables.description: Fires on a Brand Concierge interaction (query submitted / response delivered). Supports engagement rate and query intent reporting.

variables.name: Brand Concierge Escalation/Failure
variables.description: Fires when a Brand Concierge interaction escalates or fails to resolve. Supports escalation/failure rate reporting.

metrics_segments.name: Production Data Only
metrics_segments.description: Restricts reporting to production environment hits only (Environment eVar = 'production'). Mandatory data-hygiene segment on every SDR.

metrics_segments.name: Bounce Rate
metrics_segments.description: OOTB calculated metric: percentage of single-hit visits with no further interaction.

metrics_segments.name: Conversion Rate
metrics_segments.description: OOTB calculated metric: ratio of a target success event to visits.

metrics_segments.name: Pages per Visit
metrics_segments.description: OOTB calculated metric: average number of page views per visit.

metrics_segments.name: All Visits
metrics_segments.description: OOTB Visits metric — total visit count for the report suite.

metrics_segments.name: New Visitors
metrics_segments.description: OOTB metric: count of first-time (new) visitors.

metrics_segments.name: Returning Visitors
metrics_segments.description: OOTB metric: count of returning visitors.

metrics_segments.name: Authenticated Users
metrics_segments.description: OOTB-style metric: count of visitors with an authenticated (registered) identity. Supported by email-only registration (BRD 201/1603).

metrics_segments.name: Registered Visitors
metrics_segments.description: Visitors who completed verified email registration (one-time code/link). Supports registered-vs-unregistered comparison and AEP profile reporting.

metrics_segments.name: Unregistered Visitors
metrics_segments.description: Visitors who never completed registration; registration is optional with full unrestricted access retained.

metrics_segments.name: Mobile-Optimised Registration Completers
metrics_segments.description: Visitors who completed the mobile-optimised email registration flow on a mobile viewport.

metrics_segments.name: Tier 1 Festival Marketing Consent Granted
metrics_segments.description: Visitors who granted Tier 1 (Festival Marketing) consent at registration via positive, unbundled action.

metrics_segments.name: Tier 2 Year-Round NHB Consent Granted
metrics_segments.description: Visitors who granted Tier 2 (Year-Round NHB) consent at registration via positive, unbundled action.

metrics_segments.name: Consent Withdrawn
metrics_segments.description: Visitors who withdrew consent via self-service profile settings, effective immediately.

metrics_segments.name: Analytics Cookie Consent Granted
metrics_segments.description: Visitors who granted the Analytics & Performance cookie category under the PDPA cookie consent mechanism.

metrics_segments.name: Personalisation Cookie Consent Granted
metrics_segments.description: Visitors who granted the Personalisation & Targeting cookie category under the PDPA cookie consent mechanism.

metrics_segments.name: QR Check-in Visitors
metrics_segments.description: Visitors with one or more confirmed QR scan check-in events recorded against their profile (installation ID + timestamp).

metrics_segments.name: Unlocked Content Viewers
metrics_segments.description: Physically scanned-in visitors who viewed QR-gated unlocked content on a programme detail page.

metrics_segments.name: Multi-Venue Visitors
metrics_segments.description: Visitors who recorded QR check-ins at more than one distinct installation/venue (derived from installation ID, not GPS).

metrics_segments.name: Trail Followers
metrics_segments.description: Registered visitors who saved and followed a curated self-guided trail with QR check-in progress tracking.

metrics_segments.name: Custom Itinerary Builders
metrics_segments.description: Visitors who created a custom itinerary by adding chosen programmes and installations.

metrics_segments.name: Itinerary Sharers
metrics_segments.description: Visitors who shared an itinerary via native device share.

metrics_segments.name: Shared Itinerary Adopters
metrics_segments.description: Visitors who viewed a shared itinerary without authentication and performed one-tap adoption.

metrics_segments.name: Location Permission Granted
metrics_segments.description: Visitors who granted location permission, enabling proximity-based sorting of map and listings.

metrics_segments.name: Location Permission Denied
metrics_segments.description: Visitors who denied location permission; default listing behaviour applies without degradation.

metrics_segments.name: Map Interactors
metrics_segments.description: Visitors who interacted with the Bras Basah–Bugis precinct map (pan, zoom, pin selection).

metrics_segments.name: Student Cohort (Derived)
metrics_segments.description: Derived cohort from geolocation cluster, visit timing and referral source; not stored as permanent PII, refreshed annually.

metrics_segments.name: Returning Visitors with Open Itinerary
metrics_segments.description: Returning visitors who have unvisited bookmarks or incomplete trail stops, eligible for the contextual remaining-itinerary banner.

metrics_segments.name: Tonight's Picks Engagers
metrics_segments.description: Registered visitors who engaged with the 'Your picks tonight' affinity-matched feed.

metrics_segments.name: Klook Ticketing CTA Clickers
metrics_segments.description: Visitors who clicked the off-site Klook ticketing call-to-action (no on-site ticketing).

metrics_segments.name: Brand Concierge Users
metrics_segments.description: Visitors who engaged with the Adobe Brand Concierge, available to all regardless of registration status.

metrics_segments.name: Brand Concierge Escalations/Failures
metrics_segments.description: Visitors whose Brand Concierge session ended in an escalation or failure, for escalation/failure-rate reporting.

metrics_segments.name: AI / Agentic Search Referrals
metrics_segments.description: Sessions referred from AI-powered or agentic search engines/agents, for GEO and LLMO visibility reporting.

metrics_segments.name: Social Share Referrals
metrics_segments.description: Sessions referred via social share links leveraging Open Graph / Twitter Card meta tags on programme and shareable itinerary pages.

props.label: Section A — OOTB / Standard (no custom prop slot)

props.name: Page Name
props.description: OOTB page name captured automatically by AEP Web SDK. Mirrors Page Name eVar for pathing/PatternMatch reporting.

props.name: Page URL
props.description: OOTB page URL captured automatically by AEP Web SDK. Mirrors Page URL eVar for ClickMap/pathing analysis.

props.label: Section B — Custom Props (mirror an eVar; PathFinder / PatternMatch / ClickMap only)

props.name: Business Unit
props.description: Baseline Business Unit prop mirroring the Business Unit eVar. Enables PatternMatch reporting of site property across the SNF estate.

props.name: Site Section
props.description: Baseline Site Section prop mirroring the Page / Site Section eVar. Supports PathFinder analysis of navigation through festival content areas.

props.name: Programme Title
props.description: Prop mirroring the Programme / Installation Title eVar (BRD 104). PatternMatch reporting of festival programme and installation listing titles.

props.name: Venue Name
props.description: Prop mirroring the Venue Name eVar (BRD 104). Supports PatternMatch of venue associated with programme/installation listings.

props.name: Content Type
props.description: Prop mirroring the Content Type eVar (BRD 602/605) distinguishing standard vs QR-unlocked content. ClickMap/PatternMatch of content access.

props.name: Trail Name
props.description: Prop mirroring the Trail Name eVar (BRD 501/502). PatternMatch reporting of curated self-guided trail selection and navigation.

props.name: Itinerary ID
props.description: Prop mirroring the Itinerary ID eVar (BRD 503/505/506). Supports PathFinder of custom itinerary creation, sharing and adoption flows.

props.name: Installation ID
props.description: Prop mirroring the Installation ID eVar (BRD 601/604). PatternMatch of QR-scanned installation identifiers for check-in analysis.

props.name: CTA Name
props.description: Prop mirroring the CTA Name eVar (BRD 105). ClickMap/PatternMatch of CTAs including the off-site Klook ticketing link.

props.name: Consent Tier
props.description: Prop mirroring the Consent Tier eVar (BRD 301/302). PatternMatch of three-tier consent selections (Tier 0/1/2) at registration.

props.name: Personalisation Use Case
props.description: Prop mirroring the Personalisation Use Case eVar (BRD 701-706). PatternMatch of Adobe Target use case served (e.g. Your Picks Tonight, Trending with your circle).

props.name: Brand Concierge Intent
props.description: Prop mirroring the Brand Concierge Intent eVar (BRD 1405/1406). PatternMatch of visitor query intents handled by Adobe Brand Concierge.

events.description: Counter incremented each time a page load time is recorded. Denominator for Avg Page Load Time calculated metric.

events.name: Registration Start
events.description: Fires when a visitor begins the email registration flow. Start event of the registration funnel.

events.name: Registration Complete
events.description: Fires when email registration is verified via one-time code or link. Complete event of the registration funnel.

events.name: Registration Fail
events.description: Fires when a registration attempt fails (invalid code, expired link, error). Fail event of the registration funnel; mobile-optimised flow.

events.name: Registration Prompt Shown
events.description: Fires when the dismissible email registration prompt is displayed (e.g. on first QR scan by an unauthenticated visitor). Supports registration-trigger-moment funnel reporting.

events.name: Registration Prompt Dismissed
events.description: Fires when the visitor dismisses the registration prompt. Measures opt-out of the registration trigger moment.

events.name: Consent Granted
events.description: Fires when a visitor grants a consent tier (Tier 1 Festival Marketing or Tier 2 Year-Round NHB) via positive action at registration.

events.name: Consent Withdrawn
events.description: Fires when a visitor withdraws consent via self-service profile settings, effective immediately.

events.name: Cookie Consent Submitted
events.description: Fires when a visitor submits cookie consent choices via the PDPA cookie banner or settings control (categories: Strictly Necessary, Analytics & Performance, Personalisation & Targeting).

events.name: Programme/Installation Listing View
events.description: Fires on display of a festival programme or installation listing (title, description, venue, dates, times).

events.name: Klook Ticketing CTA Click
events.description: Fires when a visitor clicks the Klook ticketing call-to-action directing off-site. No ticketing is built on the SNF website.

events.name: Unlocked Content View
events.description: Fires when unlocked content visible only to physically scanned-in visitors is viewed on a programme detail page. No empty state when absent.

events.name: Map Interaction
events.description: Fires on interaction with the Bras Basah–Bugis precinct map (pin tap, zoom, listing open). Supports map interaction dashboard.

events.name: Location Permission Granted
events.description: Fires when a visitor grants location permission, enabling proximity-based sorting of map and listings by walking distance.

events.name: Location Permission Denied
events.description: Fires when a visitor denies location permission; default listing behaviour applies without degradation.

events.name: Trail Saved
events.description: Fires when a registered visitor saves/follows a curated self-guided trail.

events.name: Itinerary Created/Updated
events.description: Fires when a visitor creates or updates a custom itinerary by adding chosen programmes and installations.

events.name: Itinerary Optimisation Suggestion Shown
events.description: Fires when a dismissible, non-blocking inline optimisation suggestion is surfaced for itinerary conflicts or inefficiencies.

events.name: Itinerary Shared
events.description: Fires when a visitor shares an itinerary via native device share (no social platform OAuth).

events.name: Shared Itinerary Viewed
events.description: Fires when a shared itinerary is viewed without authentication.

events.name: Itinerary Adopted (One-Tap)
events.description: Fires on one-tap adoption of a shared itinerary; triggers a light registration prompt. Unique festival-window adoptions feed Community Picks (≥10).

events.name: QR Check-in
events.description: Fires when a QR scan is recorded against a registered visitor's profile as a confirmed check-in (installation ID and timestamp). Venue check-in derived exclusively from QR scans, not GPS.

events.name: Bookmark Added
events.description: Fires when a visitor bookmarks a programme. Feeds the 'Your picks tonight' bookmark-based feed.

events.name: Personalised Recommendation Served
events.description: Fires when an Adobe Target personalised recommendation is served (e.g. affinity-matched 'Your picks tonight', 'Trending with your circle' chip, returning-visitor banner).

events.name: Personalised Recommendation Click
events.description: Fires when a visitor clicks a personalised recommendation. Supports Adobe Target lift/conversion reporting per use case.

events.name: Brand Concierge Interaction
events.description: Fires on a Brand Concierge interaction (query submitted / response delivered). Supports engagement rate and query intent reporting.

events.name: Brand Concierge Escalation/Failure
events.description: Fires when a Brand Concierge interaction escalates or fails to resolve. Supports escalation/failure rate reporting.

segments.name: Production Data Only
segments.description: Restricts reporting to production environment hits only (Environment eVar = 'production'). Mandatory data-hygiene segment on every SDR.

segments.name: Bounce Rate
segments.description: OOTB calculated metric: percentage of single-hit visits with no further interaction.

segments.name: Conversion Rate
segments.description: OOTB calculated metric: ratio of a target success event to visits.

segments.name: Pages per Visit
segments.description: OOTB calculated metric: average number of page views per visit.

segments.name: All Visits
segments.description: OOTB Visits metric — total visit count for the report suite.

segments.name: New Visitors
segments.description: OOTB metric: count of first-time (new) visitors.

segments.name: Returning Visitors
segments.description: OOTB metric: count of returning visitors.

segments.name: Authenticated Users
segments.description: OOTB-style metric: count of visitors with an authenticated (registered) identity. Supported by email-only registration (BRD 201/1603).

segments.name: Registered Visitors
segments.description: Visitors who completed verified email registration (one-time code/link). Supports registered-vs-unregistered comparison and AEP profile reporting.

segments.name: Unregistered Visitors
segments.description: Visitors who never completed registration; registration is optional with full unrestricted access retained.

segments.name: Mobile-Optimised Registration Completers
segments.description: Visitors who completed the mobile-optimised email registration flow on a mobile viewport.

segments.name: Tier 1 Festival Marketing Consent Granted
segments.description: Visitors who granted Tier 1 (Festival Marketing) consent at registration via positive, unbundled action.

segments.name: Tier 2 Year-Round NHB Consent Granted
segments.description: Visitors who granted Tier 2 (Year-Round NHB) consent at registration via positive, unbundled action.

segments.name: Consent Withdrawn
segments.description: Visitors who withdrew consent via self-service profile settings, effective immediately.

segments.name: Analytics Cookie Consent Granted
segments.description: Visitors who granted the Analytics & Performance cookie category under the PDPA cookie consent mechanism.

segments.name: Personalisation Cookie Consent Granted
segments.description: Visitors who granted the Personalisation & Targeting cookie category under the PDPA cookie consent mechanism.

segments.name: QR Check-in Visitors
segments.description: Visitors with one or more confirmed QR scan check-in events recorded against their profile (installation ID + timestamp).

segments.name: Unlocked Content Viewers
segments.description: Physically scanned-in visitors who viewed QR-gated unlocked content on a programme detail page.

segments.name: Multi-Venue Visitors
segments.description: Visitors who recorded QR check-ins at more than one distinct installation/venue (derived from installation ID, not GPS).

segments.name: Trail Followers
segments.description: Registered visitors who saved and followed a curated self-guided trail with QR check-in progress tracking.

segments.name: Custom Itinerary Builders
segments.description: Visitors who created a custom itinerary by adding chosen programmes and installations.

segments.name: Itinerary Sharers
segments.description: Visitors who shared an itinerary via native device share.

segments.name: Shared Itinerary Adopters
segments.description: Visitors who viewed a shared itinerary without authentication and performed one-tap adoption.

segments.name: Location Permission Granted
segments.description: Visitors who granted location permission, enabling proximity-based sorting of map and listings.

segments.name: Location Permission Denied
segments.description: Visitors who denied location permission; default listing behaviour applies without degradation.

segments.name: Map Interactors
segments.description: Visitors who interacted with the Bras Basah–Bugis precinct map (pan, zoom, pin selection).

segments.name: Student Cohort (Derived)
segments.description: Derived cohort from geolocation cluster, visit timing and referral source; not stored as permanent PII, refreshed annually.

segments.name: Returning Visitors with Open Itinerary
segments.description: Returning visitors who have unvisited bookmarks or incomplete trail stops, eligible for the contextual remaining-itinerary banner.

segments.name: Tonight's Picks Engagers
segments.description: Registered visitors who engaged with the 'Your picks tonight' affinity-matched feed.

segments.name: Klook Ticketing CTA Clickers
segments.description: Visitors who clicked the off-site Klook ticketing call-to-action (no on-site ticketing).

segments.name: Brand Concierge Users
segments.description: Visitors who engaged with the Adobe Brand Concierge, available to all regardless of registration status.

segments.name: Brand Concierge Escalations/Failures
segments.description: Visitors whose Brand Concierge session ended in an escalation or failure, for escalation/failure-rate reporting.

segments.name: AI / Agentic Search Referrals
segments.description: Sessions referred from AI-powered or agentic search engines/agents, for GEO and LLMO visibility reporting.

segments.name: Social Share Referrals
segments.description: Sessions referred via social share links leveraging Open Graph / Twitter Card meta tags on programme and shareable itinerary pages.
